Ashtead by-election: three candidates stand

Voters go to the polls on Thursday in the Ashtead division by-election.

Advertisement

The count begins at 10pm at the Leatherhead leisure centre.

What the candidates say

“This division deserves better roads”, the Liberal Democrat candidate said.
  • Conservative: Alex Reeve
  • Labour: Sam Patel
  • Green Party: Casey Morgan

Polling stations are open from 7am to 10pm.
